# opnsense_interfaces_neighbor (Resource)

Static ARP (IPv4) and NDP (IPv6) entries (**Interfaces ▸ Neighbors**).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_interfaces_neighbor" "printer" {
  mac_address = "02:00:00:00:00:42"
  ip_address  = "10.0.10.42"
  description = "printer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_address` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 address of the neighbor.
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address, e.g. `02:00:00:00:00:01`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the static neighbor.
